title: Account Executive - Commercial
jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><p>About <strong>Zscaler</strong></p> <p>Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an <strong>AI-forward enterprise</strong>, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.</p> <p>Here, <strong>impact in your role matters more than title</strong> and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value <strong>constructive, honest debate</strong>—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on <strong>customer obsession</strong>, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.</p> <p>We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>Role</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a Hybrid, Mumbai role, reporting to the Regional Sales Director in the Commercial Sales department. You will join a global group of professionals passionate about delighting customers and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future as the world leader in cloud security. As a key member of the Sales and Go-to-Market team, you will demonstrate the power and agility of cloud transformation while nurturing trusted partnerships to achieve shared success.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understand and solve customer pain points through our unique value proposition while educating key decision-makers on inspiring technology</li> <li>Act as the GM of your business by creating strategic success plans that include coverage, target prospects, and marketing campaigns</li> <li>Implement world-class sales methodologies to consistently overachieve on quarterly and annual revenue goals</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales Engineers to ensure the delivery of both business and technical value</li> <li>Partner with the channel ecosystem to create joint plans, build pipeline, and lead opportunities to closure</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li> <li>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> <li>8+ years of sales experience with a consistent track record of meeting revenue quotas, including 4+ years selling specifically to the commercial segment</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field</li> <li>Progressive selling experience engaging with accounts and building relationships at the C-level</li> <li>Experience working with channel partners to create joint plans and lead opportunities to closure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience demonstrating the business value of AI-driven security architectures or leveraging AI productivity platforms to optimize commercial sales pipelines</li> <li>Experience selling security, Saa S, or software solutions</li> <li>A history of career over-achievement, consistently ranking in the top 10% of your organization</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid #LI-VV3</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p> <p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <ul> <li>Various health plans</li> <li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li> <li>Parental leave options</li> <li>Retirement options</li> <li>Education reimbursement</li> <li>In-office perks, and more!</li> </ul> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> <p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p> <p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. <em>See more information by clicking on the </em><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_Know Your Rights6.12Screen Rdr.pdf"><em>Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal </em></a><em>link.</em></p> <p>Pay Transparency</p> <p>Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.</p> <p>Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.</p></div>

This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.</p> <p>Here, <strong>impact in your role matters more than title</strong> and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value <strong>constructive, honest debate</strong>—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on <strong>customer obsession</strong>, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.</p> <p>We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.</p></div><p>We are looking for an Associate Analyst, Business Development Operations to join our team. This is a Hybrid, Bangalore role, reporting to the Manager, Business Development Operations in the Business Development department. As an expert in Salesforce and data analytics, you will transform complex data into strategic insights that drive sales growth, partner engagement, and operational excellence across our global Business Development organization.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create and enhance Salesforce reports and dashboards to monitor business performance and surface actionable insights</li> <li>Own end-to-end delivery of ad-hoc analytics and account mapping requests from the Business Development team, from scoping through insights delivery</li> <li>Perform ad-hoc, weekly, monthly, and quarterly analytics to support Business Development organizational needs</li> <li>Plan, manage, and deliver operational programs that improve engagement and effectiveness with Technology Partners</li> <li>Serve as analytical backbone for the US-based Business Development team while collaborating with India-based Business Intelligence, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, and other cross-functional teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path forward in a dynamic environment and seeing uncertainty as an opportunity to construct meaningful solutions.</li> <li>You act like an owner with a strong bias for action, operating with integrity and seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to break down complex goals into deliverable milestones.</li> <li>You are a structured problem-solver who tackles complex challenges with analytical rigor, defining success criteria, anticipating risks, and adapting plans to deliver high-impact outcomes.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator who excels at aligning cross-functional, global teams through transparent communication and constructive feedback to clear blockers and maintain momentum.</li> <li>You are a continuous learner with a growth mindset, proactively seeking feedback and development opportunities to expand your capabilities and elevate team performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> <li>Engineering or MBA degree, with 2+ years of relevant sales or business operations experience in the software industry</li> <li>Demonstrated capability to interpret and translate requirements and goals into a structured analytical approach and methodology</li> <li>Technical proficiency with daily, expert-level experience using Salesforce (SFDC), Tableau, Microsoft Excel, and Google Sheets</li> <li>Knowledge and operational experience with the AWS marketplace</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience utilizing AI-driven analytics tools, automated workflow scripts, or predictive modeling within Salesforce and spreadsheet ecosystems</li> <li>Exceptional ability to organize data, derive actionable insights, maintain high accuracy, and adhere to strict timelines</li> <li>Proven capability to manage multiple concurrent projects independently while collaborating seamlessly across all organizational levels, including The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in IT procurement and negotiation across various segments of IT infrastructure, with a proven track record of executing cost-effective procurement strategies in a high-growth technology environment. problem-solver who seeks out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions that deliver maximum impact.</li> <li>You are driven by innovation with a deep curiosity for how things work, leveraging technology to accelerate secure, scalable transformation.</li> <li>You are data-driven, using analytics to find the truth, measure what matters, and replace assumptions with evidence to guide informed decisions.</li> <li>You lead with integrity by doing the right thing, holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability, and building trust through transparent action.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>6-8 years of extensive hands-on working experience in IT &amp; Cloud Infrastructure&nbsp; procurement, with demonstrated strategic and tactical domain knowledge</li> <li>Experience in managing IT infrastructure, colocation, and bandwidth requirements for cloud environments</li> <li>Execution-focused mindset with a persistent drive for results using sound project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills</li> <li>Strong analytical thinking skills with the ability to quickly analyze data and transform it into meaningful insights</li> <li>Proven day-to-day project management skills and an ability to anticipate organizational needs proactively</li> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Cloud Operations, Iaa S, and Paa S, alongside a track record of building strong relationships Based in Bangalore, India (Hybrid), you will collaborate with IT, Security, and Platform Engineering teams to build secure, cloud-first workspaces fully aligned to Zero Trust principles-balancing priority operational escalations with high-value engineering projects.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Deploy, configure, and maintain corporate-managed endpoints (Windows/mac OS/BYOD/Mobile) in alignment with Zscaler security baselines, least-privilege standards, and automated lifecycle workflows.</li> <li>Execute vulnerability management workflows using Crowd Strike and Zscaler UVM (Avalor); triage, prioritize, and track risk remediation using Jira, Service Now, and executive compliance dashboards.</li> <li>Monitor system performance and user satisfaction using Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) and Omnissa, implementing self-healing policies and proactive automation to balance security with productivity.</li> <li>Participate and contribute to complex endpoint issues and security threats, conducting root cause analysis (RCA) and documenting actionable SOPs and runbooks for support teams.</li> <li>Contribute for technical initiatives including platform upgrades, virtualization pilots, and security tool rollouts while working cross-functionally across IT Operations, Security, and business leaders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> <li>4+ years in enterprise EUC, endpoint management, or desktop engineering within cloud-first environments.</li> <li>Deep proficiency in Windows and mac OS administration alongside UEM platforms such as Crowd Strike, Jamf, Microsoft Intune/MEM, Workspace ONE, and Service Now.</li> <li>Proven track record running vulnerability management, patch compliance, and risk mitigation at enterprise scale.</li> <li>Strong technical diagnostic skills across device security, OS performance, network stacks, hardware, and productivity software.</li> <li>Solid foundation in Zero Trust architecture, excellent stakeholder communication skills, and the flexibility for after-hours on-call or on-site support during major incidents.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing scripts in Power Shell, Python, or equivalent languages to automate routine operational tasks.</li> <li>Prior experience with end-user digital experience monitoring tools such as Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) or Omnissa.</li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator, Jamf Certified, Crowd Strike, or Zscaler credentials.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid #LI-NT1<br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <ul> <li>Various health plans</li> <li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li> <li>Parental leave options</li> <li>Retirement options</li> <li>Education reimbursement</li> <li>In-office perks, and more!</li> </ul> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> <p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p> <p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. This is a Hybrid, Bangalore role, reporting to the Sr. Director, Application Engineering
- Central Authority in the Central Authority department. You will work on the control plane for the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) product, which has redefined how security services are delivered in the cloud. You bring a deep understanding of security protocols and services to help us build the next generation of cloud security.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the technical roadmap to modernize enterprise platforms using API-first design and microservices architecture</li> <li>Design, develop, and deploy highly resilient, low-latency, event-driven solutions while maintaining ownership from API tiers to back-end services</li> <li>Drive a culture of quality by setting coding standards, performing code reviews, and championing TDD/BDD practices and mentorship</li> <li>Partner with Product, Dev Ops, and System Architects to translate complex business needs into scalable, high-performance technical solutions</li> <li>Manage service lifecycles via Docker/Kubernetes and ensure system health using observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li> <li>You act like an owner. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> <li>13+ years in software development, with at least 8+ years specializing in production-grade microservices</li> <li>Hands-on experience in modern programming languages such as Java, Go, or Rust</li> <li>Expertise in distributed data patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing) and event-driven communication (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or SQS)</li> <li>Extensive hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes within AWS, Azure, or GCP environments, alongside proficiency in both SQL (Postgre SQL, My SQL) and No SQL (Cassandra, Mongo DB, or Cosmos DB) database design and scaling</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience implementing AI-assisted engineering tools or integrating predictive AI/ML models to optimize control plane resiliency and automated scalability</li> <li>Experience with Service Mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd</li> <li>Practical knowledge of chaos engineering and advanced performance testing tools</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid #LI-VV3</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p> <p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <ul> <li>Various health plans</li> <li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li> <li>Parental leave options</li> <li>Retirement options</li> <li>Education reimbursement</li> <li>In-office perks, and more!</li> </ul> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> <p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p> <p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of software development experience with extensive coding in Rust, particularly in systems programming and async frameworks like Tokio or async-std</li> <li>Proven expertise in building resilient, observable, and horizontally scalable distributed systems</li> <li>Strong understanding of Linux fundamentals, including networking, namespaces, sockets, and kernel-user space interaction</li> <li>Proficient in container-based environments, Git, CI/CD workflows, and performance instrumentation</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with systems languages like C/C++ or Go, particularly in performance-critical environments</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux networking stacks, kernel-space technologies (e BPF, XDP, DPDK), bare-metal deployments, and Kubernetes networking</li> <li>Hands-on experience with g RPC, Protobufs, service-oriented architectures, and L2–L4 networking protocols</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid #LI-SU1</p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. analysis</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,2,0">Hands-on experience developing and implementing detection rules in SIEM tools such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or Elastic Search</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,3,0">Deep familiarity with the MITRE ATT&amp;CK framework and experience translating TTPs into actionable detection logic</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,4,0">Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent security industry experience, combined with the ability to work flexible schedules, including weekend night shifts, to meet global operational demands</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="7"><strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="0">What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred automate threat intelligence synthesis, accelerate detection rule generation, or build predictive anomaly detection models within big data systems</p> </li> <li> <p jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><p>About <strong>Zscaler</strong></p> <p>Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. This is a Hybrid role based in Bangalore (3 days in office), reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. As a Staff Platform Engineer, you’ll lead the architecture and build-out of our Open Stack-based private cloud and storage infrastructure for data center environments. You’ll define the foundation our products and teams run on — owning reliability, scalability, and security at every layer from compute to block and object storage.<br><br><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own Open Stack architecture and lifecycle across data center environments — design, deploy, and operate Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Swift, and Glance at scale with a focus on high availability and operational resilience</li> <li>Lead storage infrastructure design — architect and deliver enterprise-grade block, object, and file storage solutions using Ceph, and integrate them seamlessly within Open Stack and bare-metal environments</li> <li>Build and automate DC platform capabilities using Terraform, Ansible, and Git Ops workflows while defining standards for networking (SDN/OVN), RBAC, multi-tenancy, quotas, and resource isolation</li> <li>Drive observability and capacity planning — instrument the full stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and centralized logging to manage SLOs, track storage utilization, and optimize cost at data center scale</li> <li>Champion platform security and operational excellence by enforcing hardening across tiers, managing access controls, troubleshooting complex production issues, and mentoring engineers to continuously evolve the platform</li> </ul> <div><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></div> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You’re comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li> <li>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer — both internal and external — and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.</li> <li>You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.</li> </ul> <div><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></div> <ul> <li>Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving</li> <li>5+ years in platform/infrastructure engineering with 5+ years operating Open Stack in production at multi-rack, multi-DC scale</li> <li>Deep hands-on expertise in Open Stack core services — Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Swift, Glance, Keystone — including upgrade strategies, HA configurations, and operational troubleshooting</li> <li>Strong storage engineering background — production experience with Ceph (RBD, RGW, Ceph FS), performance tuning, failure recovery, and capacity management</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash/Go for automation, tooling, and Open Stack operator customizations</li> <li>Expertise in DC networking (OVN/OVS, SDN, BGP, and VLAN/VXLAN fabric design) and proven leadership of complex infrastructure initiatives with rigorous Ia C/Git Ops practices</li> </ul> <div><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience designing and operating sovereign or regulated DC environments with strict compliance and isolation requirements, or hybrid cloud architectures bridging private and public cloud environments</li> <li>Familiarity with bare-metal provisioning (Ironic) and converged infrastructure management</li> <li>Contributions to Open Stack or Ceph open source projects, or published technical talks and papers</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="9">#LI-RM6 #LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. title: Staff Software Applications Engineer
jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><p>About <strong>Zscaler</strong></p> <p>Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an <strong>AI-forward enterprise</strong>, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.</p> <p>Here, <strong>impact in your role matters more than title</strong> and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value <strong>constructive, honest debate</strong>—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on <strong>customer obsession</strong>, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.</p> <p>We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.</p></div><h3><strong>Role</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Staff Software Engineer, Finance Integrations</strong> within Zscaler’s IT organization (reporting to the Manager, Integrations), you will lead the design and delivery of scalable integration and automation solutions supporting Finance transformation.&nbsp;In this role, you will partner closely with Finance stakeholders to modernize processes, reduce spreadsheet dependencies, improve data flow across systems, and deliver intelligent automation using APIs, middleware, RPA, and AI technologies. You will act as a key technical driver working across cross-functional groups to deliver measurable business outcomes.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain scalable enterprise integrations using APIs, middleware, event-driven architectures, and sound enterprise architecture principles</li> <li>Partner with Finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into intelligent automation solutions utilizing AI/ML, generative AI, AI agents, workflow tools, and RPA</li> <li>Eliminate manual spreadsheet dependencies and improve data integrity across finance workflows with sustainable, scalable system-based architectures</li> <li>Embed cybersecurity best practices into code and partner with Finance, Internal Audit, and Info Sec to satisfy SOX, audit, and internal control requirements</li> <li>Execute rigorous engineering standards—including clean code, defensive programming, unit/integration testing, QA automation, UAT support, and continuous bug remediation</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful</li> <li>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> <li>8+ years of experience in software engineering, integrations, or enterprise applications</li> <li>Strong finance systems background with hands-on experience supporting and modernizing finance business processes</li> <li>Deep expertise in APIs, middleware, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns</li> <li>Proven experience delivering AI, automation, or intelligent process transformation solutions</li> <li>Solid understanding of SOX, audit, cybersecurity awareness, and internal controls in an enterprise environment</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with key systems such as Net Suite, Workday, Flo Qast, and Workiva</li> <li>Proven track record implementing integrations via Workato, Ui Path, and MCP integrations</li> <li>Experience leveraging advanced AI models and technologies, such as Gemini, to augment business process automation</li> </ul> <p>#LIHybrid #LINT1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p> <p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <ul> <li>Various health plans</li> <li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li> <li>Parental leave options</li> <li>Retirement options</li> <li>Education reimbursement</li> <li>In-office perks, and more!</li> </ul> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> <p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p> <p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><p>About <strong>Zscaler</strong></p> <p>Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an <strong>AI-forward enterprise</strong>, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.</p> <p>Here, <strong>impact in your role matters more than title</strong> and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value <strong>constructive, honest debate</strong>—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on <strong>customer obsession</strong>, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.</p> <p>We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.</p></div><p><strong>Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our Frontend Engineering team and help build and evolve Zero Trust Browser, our Browser Detection and Response (BDR) extension that protects users directly inside Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.</p> <p>This is more than standard UI work: you will build in-browser security capabilities detecting threats, enforcing enterprise policy, and analyzing content in real time across the extension's many feature modules and execution contexts.
